settings.secretBody:
If you found this tiny star tucked into the corner, you pay attention to every little detail—just like you always do.

No matter how old we get, I promise to always keep building little worlds just to see you smile.

Redeemable anytime for: one spontaneous midnight drive, your favorite dessert, and my undivided attention.
settings.finalLine1: And this isn't even the whole story.
settings.finalLine2: There are still so many pictures we haven't taken, places we haven't been, stupid jokes we haven't made, and memories we haven't created yet.

memories.title: The day everything felt a little different.
memories.story: I don't know if you remember this day the way I do. Nothing extraordinary happened on paper—we were just talking, losing track of time, and laughing at things nobody else would understand. Somehow this ordinary moment became one of those memories that stayed with me forever.

memories.title: Two coffees & three hours of talking
memories.story: We sat there until our drinks went completely cold because neither of us wanted to be the first one to say goodbye. Replace this sample with one of your favorite candid snapshots of us.

memories.title: Late night drives & half-asleep playlists
memories.story: Windows cracked open, your favorite song playing quietly, and the whole city asleep while we talked about everything we want to do in our twenties.

memories.title: Just you, effortlessly being my favorite view
memories.story: You always say you look messy in candid photos, and you never believe me when I tell you those are the exact pictures I look at the most.

timelineEras.subtitle: Before I knew how important you would become.
Somewhere along the way, you became my favorite person.
More memories than I can count.

loveList: The way your eyes light up before you even finish telling a story
Your laugh—especially when you try to hold it back and fail
How you make even a random Tuesday errand feel like a mini adventure
The gentleness you carry with the people you care about
Your terrible, wonderful sense of humor that catches me off guard
The way you remember tiny details nobody else notices
How safe and calm everything feels whenever you are next to me
Your sleepy voice when it’s late and you refuse to admit you’re tired
The passion you put into the things you truly love
How effortlessly cute you are without even trying
The little expressions you make when you’re thinking hard
Your honesty, even when it’s vulnerable
The way you look at me when we’re in a crowded room
How you get excited over small, simple things
Your resilience on days when life feels heavy
The comfort of holding your hand while walking nowhere in particular
Every inside joke that only makes sense to the two of us
How you inspire me to become a better person every single day
The warmth you bring into every space you walk into
That you let me be completely myself around you
Simply that you exist—and that out of everyone in the world, I get to love you

openWhen.title: Open when you're having a bad day
openWhen.message:
Take a deep breath, my love. Whatever happened today does not define you, and you don't have to carry it all by yourself.

Text or call me right now—even if you don't want advice and just want me to listen, bring you snacks, or sit quietly with you. I'm always in your corner.

openWhen.title: Open when you miss me
openWhen.message:
If you’re reading this, there is a 99.9% chance I’m already missing you too.

Close your eyes for five seconds, picture me pulling you into the biggest hug, and remember that no matter where we are right now, my heart is always right beside yours.

openWhen.title: Open when you need a reminder
openWhen.message:
Here is your official reminder:

You are kind, you are capable, you are deeply loved, and you are doing so much better than you give yourself credit for. Please be gentle with yourself today.

openWhen.title: Open when you can't sleep
openWhen.message:
Put your phone on dim after reading this, get cozy under your blanket, and let your shoulders drop.

Imagine we’re stargazing somewhere quiet with zero alarms set for tomorrow. Count three good things from this week, and let yourself rest.

openWhen.title: Open when you want to smile
openWhen.message:
Just remembering the sound of your laugh makes me smile.

Think about our funniest inside joke right now—and remember I owe you a spontaneous ice cream / coffee run the very next time I see you.

openWhen.title: Open when you're wondering how much I love you
openWhen.message:
More than words on a screen could ever hold.

I love you in the big milestone moments, and I love you even more in the quiet, ordinary seconds in between. Happy 21st birthday, my favorite person.
